headline: T Swift Drops a 202-Burger While Stroud Boys Drop Their Pants
subhead: Week 3 featured a 200-point detonation, an 89-point execution, and Egbukkake leaving an entire second team rotting on the bench.
matchOfTheWeek: Browning Out 109.52, QAmon 108.26 — a 1.26-point heart attack that probably aged @KyleDech a decade. Turf Toe Joe and the Tiny-Handed Vampire combined for a respectable showing, but @Patrickreegs squeaked it out in the kind of game where if one of your kickers sneezes the wrong way you lose. Both rosters looked mid; only one of them gets to pretend it didn't.
powerRankingsShakeup: T swift's Baddies kicked the door off the hinges with 202 and announced themselves as the team to beat, while Stroud Boys are in freefall after a 92-point fart that had The Prodigal Son and Money Mill$ both AWOL.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. T swift's Baddies dropped TWO HUNDRED points on OnlyFants and it wasn't even her best lineup — Luther Burden left 19.8 on the pine. Jake Ferguson (27.70), Lamar (27.02), and Gibbs (26.90) ran a clinic while @ChrisCubby watched Mark Andrews put up 30.1 ON HIS BENCH. Cubby, you started the wrong tight end in a week your opponent dropped a deuce-hundo. That's not a loss, that's a hate crime.

Meanwhile in the Christian McCalfinjury vs. Stroud Boys 'matchup,' @mattwunder hung 181.66 and beheaded @bjewett13 by 89.30. David Montgomery went for 29.4, and even with Dalton Kincaid wasting 20 on the bench it didn't matter — Stroud Boys mustered 92 points like it was 2003 standard scoring. Money Mill$ indeed.

Now, the real comedy: Egbukkake. @szara scored 125.66 and his OPTIMAL was 206.56. That's 80.9 points left on the bench, including a 40.9-point Tre Tucker eruption (PRESS IN CASE OF EMERGENCY, SZARA, THAT WAS THE EMERGENCY) and Giant Hog HHH Henry going for 33. You had a league-winning week sitting next to the Gatorade and you started Erick None instead. Perc Hurts went for 29 and you still lost by 34 to Nut Olave Your Face, who ran a 100% efficient lineup behind 29.12 from the Nail Polish Enthusiast. @nickcelli being perfectly optimized while @szara benches a 200-point ceiling is the funniest split-screen of the year.

Elsewhere, The Good Ladds rode JT's 32.8 past Little Peckers despite Omarion Hampton's 24.9 for @7BigPapi7, who then traded away picks for Kayshon Boutte like it's still August. Rub My Chubb's Geno Smith (26.06) snuck past McBridesStrangeWhiteHock by 7.74 in a game nobody asked to watch.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coordinator of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 80.9 points on the bench and somehow the optimal lineup (206.56) would've still only been the second-highest score this week — the universe is laughing at you, szara.

weeklyAwards.title: Public Execution Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: 92.36 points in a SuperFlex league is a cry for help, and Christian McCalfinjury answered it with a 89-point curb-stomp.

weeklyAwards.title: 100% Galaxy Brain
weeklyAwards.blurb: Perfect lineup, 159.92, Nail Polish Enthusiast cooking — Nick is the only manager this week who didn't sabotage himself.

weeklyAwards.title: Trade Deadline Panic Button (3 weeks early)
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 7, then immediately swapped picks for Kayshon Boutte — Unc would never.
